# Finca Querencia — San Luis de Monteverde, Costa Rica

Family-run working dairy and coffee farm (25 hectares) in San Luis de Monteverde, Puntarenas, Costa Rica,
about 15 minutes by car from Monteverde Centro and 20 from Santa Elena. Run by Tim, Murtha and family.
The farm no longer offers long-term rentals.

## What we offer
- Short-term stays on Airbnb, managed by Juan Pablo (Momo) — all listings: https://www.airbnb.com/users/profile/1769107506276589408
  - The Lilly Pad — pondside cottage, up to 3 guests: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1815581241058589345
  - La Casita — the original farmhouse, up to 3 guests: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1816116037481196914
  - The Bunkhouse — one-room cabin, being remodeled, back in a few months: https://www.querenciahomestead.com/bunkhouse.html
- Tattoo stays with Papayo Tattoo (Jackson, the owners' son): https://papayotattoo.com/pages/tattoo-booking — Instagram @papayotattoo
- Pueblo Chico Coffee, grown and honey-processed on the farm by Walker (the owners' son): https://pueblochicocoffee.com/
- Coffee tours with Walker: https://pueblochicocoffee.com/#tours
- Organic vegetables, fresh dairy and eggs: https://forms.gle/d7j6XXwjnYgQVVDt7

Website: https://www.querenciahomestead.com (English and Spanish on one page; Spanish: /?lang=es)
